gloss: uniformly excellent; all of high quality

definitions.gloss: uniformly excellent; all of high quality (of a group)
definitions.explanation: Of a group of people or things, every member being of high quality, with no weak ones. Originally of grains or fruit all of an even, good size. Often written {粒|つぶ}ぞろい.

examples.japanese: {粒揃|つぶぞろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち。
examples.english: Players who are all top quality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粒揃|つぶぞろ}いだ。
examples.english: This year's newcomers are all excellent.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧イチゴ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粒揃|つぶぞろ}いで、⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧⟦{大|おお}きくて→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧。
examples.english: This shop's strawberries are uniformly fine; every one is big and sweet.

notes:
⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ (grain) + ⟦{揃|そろ}い→揃う：01953_sorou⟧ (being matched). Praise for a group as a whole; it is not said of one person. Takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ before a noun and だ as a predicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粒揃|つぶぞろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: works of consistently high quality
- {粒揃|つぶぞろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧: a strong lineup with no weak links
- {粒揃|つぶぞろ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧: fruit of even size and quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精鋭|せいえい}→精鋭：31509_seiei⟧: the elite — a few picked as the best
- ⟦{揃|そろ}い→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: a matching set — sameness, not quality
